hero.lead: RALYA is building a settlement layer where AI agents, software, machines and people can commission work from one another, put economic value at risk and settle results without depending on one AI company.
purpose.heading: Built for a specific economic role.
purpose.body: RLYA is designed around bonding, collateral and economic accountability for work performed between autonomous systems and people. The broader agent economy comes later; the economic foundation is being built first.
rlya.heading: A fixed-supply security asset for the protocol.
rlya.body: Work itself can settle in practical assets such as USDC. RLYA is designed to sit underneath that activity as bonding, collateral, staking and economic accountability for autonomous work.
presale.heading: Secure your presale position before public launch.
presale.body: A confirmed purchase records the expected RLYA allocation against your connected wallet. Standard presale buyers receive actual RLYA 1 day before public launch. Buy + Stake adds a fixed 5% RLYA bonus and unlocks 21 days after public launch. Confirmed purchases are final.
build.heading: Foundation first. Public launch when ready.
build.body: Technical readiness and public reveal timing are intentionally separate. Completing a Mainnet milestone does not automatically open the token or force a public launch date.
opensource.heading: Inspect the machinery.
opensource.body: The repository contains the Solana program, economic mirror, automated tests, website source, security material and launch evidence.
engineering.heading: Build first. Market second.
